_comment:
'If the next card you defend with this turn is a card with combo, it gains +2{d}.'

ability_type DEFENSE_REACTION maps to ON_PLAY (trigger_types.py ABILITY_TYPE_TO_EVENT), so the effect runs when the card is played in the reaction step -- correct for a Defense Reaction CARD whose text is a played effect, not an activated ability (same PLAY-vs-INSTANT distinction documented in DSL_REFERENCE, defense-side).

MODIFY_NEXT_DEFENSE (effect_types.py:4634-4663) is the exact shape for 'the NEXT card you defend with': it queues a one-shot entry on dsl_queued_defense_mods, consumed by _apply_queued_defense_mods (play.py:646-674) inside _recalculate_total_defense, with the filter compiled and evaluated per declared defender -- the defense-side twin of MODIFY_NEXT_ATTACK. A turn-long flag-gated buff would strengthen EVERY block this turn and is wrong twice over; the queue expires unused entries at end of turn, which is what 'this turn' means here, authored explicitly as scope TURN (the default). player SELF = your own next block ('you defend with').

filter HAS_KEYWORD reads 'keyword' singular (condition_types.py:824-842); the DB spells it 'Combo' (e.g. rising_knee_thrust_yellow keywords), and matching is normalisation-insensitive. amount 2 = +2{d} (razor_ring_blue uses -1 for -1{d}, so sign convention is plain).

Shape mirrors razor_ring_blue (opponent-side -1{d}, chain scope) and matches the triage note already written for flic_flak_blue -- same card, other colour.
